news.title: Germany flash services PMI falls to 9-month low of 49.4
news.author: Steve Goldstein

copy.hook: 49.4: why a score just under 50 has economists paying attention
copy.explain: A PMI asks firms whether business grew, and 50 is the line between growing and shrinking. Germany's services, its banks, shops and hotels, just posted their weakest reading since December.
copy.takeaway: One month under 50 is a wobble. A run of them is a direction.
copy.question: Services are most of Germany's economy. Does 49.4 worry you more than a factory miss?
